title: Agent Systems Lab: when review becomes the bottleneck
summary: Four execution slots, one reviewer, two queues. A reproducible model of why faster execution can move waiting without removing it.
editorial_note: Expanded web edition: the original project announcement now includes the review-capacity experiment, reproduced results and links to the public implementation.

title: Arnesto: cómo organizo mi entorno de agentes
summary: Reglas pequeñas, skills bajo demanda, decisiones fuera del chat y límites entre herramientas. Ejemplos de mi arnés personal, con enlaces al código.
editorial_note: Edición ampliada para la web: se conserva el origen de Arnesto y se añaden decisiones y ejemplos de la versión pública del repositorio.

title: En mi estantería: Menos software, más impacto
summary: Una vez releído en papel, “Menos software, más impacto” de Eduardo Ferro Aldama ocupa su sitio en mi mini-olimpo del desarrollo de software.

title: Using AI without outsourcing the learning
summary: How we use AI matters when learning something new. A reading note on comprehension, debugging and the skills needed to supervise the work.
editorial_note: Revised for the web: the score difference is expressed in percentage points, and the study’s scope is made explicit.

title: From execution to coordination: product and engineering
summary: As implementation and coordination change, the interesting work moves toward framing problems, designing systems and making decisions.
editorial_note: Adapted from my commentary on a post by Rich Holmes. The examples are linked; the reflection and predictions are my own.

title: Equipos donde las personas crecen y quieren quedarse
summary: Casi ocho años en Eventbrite, de Staff Engineer a Engineering Manager. Un agradecimiento a las personas y a una forma de construir equipos.
editorial_note: Edición para la web: se identifica el reconocimiento que aparecía en la imagen original y se corrigen erratas.

title: Less magic, more discipline: working with context
summary: The early experiments: bringing intentional compaction into Cursor and keeping intent and context useful through longer coding sessions.
editorial_note: An early experiment from December 2025. The configuration later evolved into Arnesto.
